name: Colossus 1

timeline.event: Third substation looks completed, but it doesn't appear to be connected to the building yet. Some air-cooled chillers removed, while large cooling towers are added.
There is still construction visible in the third substation yard and next to the new cooling towers.
Third substation was expected to power the building in Fall.

All air-cooled chillers have been disconnected and/or removed from the site, leaving only the cooling towers for cooling. The third substation looks complete, with red cables connected to the building.

Anthropic [announces](https://www.anthropic.com/news/higher-limits-spacex) their agreement with SpaceX to use all of the compute capacity at Colossus 1. They state that this corresponds to more than 300 MW (presumably IT power) and over 220
We assume that Anthropic has started using Colossus 1 now, since the announcement said they would get access to 300 MW "within the month" of May.
No major changes to the data center since February. Solar panels have been placed next to the facility.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Colossus 1: current power 340 MW; owner SpaceXAI.

explain: Colossus 1 is an operating AI data center in Memphis, TN, owned by xai and used by anthropic. Epoch AI estimates it draws 340 MW today and 442 MW when finished.
